obligations.title: Correct obl-fi-pakotelaki-sanctions-offences: section 4 points to the Criminal Code for the offences and penalties
obligations.sourceLabel: Finlex, 659/1967, 4 §, consolidated text fin@20250182 of 2025-04-25, Swedish swe@20250182. Lähde: Finlex (oikeusministeriö), CC BY 4.0
obligations.why: Section 4 only says that breaching an Article 215 sanctions regulation or an order under the Act is punished under chapter 46, sections 3a to 3d of the Criminal Code; the offence elements and penalties the old text listed are in the Criminal Code, not in this Act, so the summary now says where they are.

summaries.en: Breaching, or attempting to breach, an EU sanctions regulation adopted under Article 215 TFEU, or a regulatory order an authority issues under the Act, is punishable as section 4 provides. The offences and their penalties are laid down in chapter 46, sections 3a to 3d of the Criminal Code (39/1889), to which section 4 refers.
